avis.texte: Im 34, i've tried a few different eye creams in my day. I used cocokind for years but wanted to switch it up. I used this one for a few tubes then bought cocokind to save a few bucks……i was not impressed as i once was! Now i only use Mad Hippie and wont look back.
I used a sample version and it was great. Bought the full size and my eyes turned red, swelled, and had scaly flaky skin for weeks after 2 uses.
I like this product. Better than some of thee others Ive boughten.

avis.titre: No I would not buy again
avis.texte: I was disappointed! I bought the same cream at Costco and it worked great but they must have changed the formula because this one did nothing at all :(
So smooth, helps with creasing, lasts a long time in this little tube- would 100% buy again
Gives great hydration without being too heavy or irritating along with potent actives at an AFFORDABLE price

I have very sensitive, acne prone skin. I've used so many different eye creams- high end/luxury and affordable- and have never noticed a difference in my 31 year old eyes (fine lines). this stuff is magic! my eyes look so youthful and plump. I absolutely love it. the first couple times I tried it, I had to start slow because I did feel a slight burning. but now I've been using this a few months and have no sensitivity to it. will be re-purchasing!

This bottle has so many different actives in it I was blown away. A slew of peptides, caffeine, hesperidin, literally everything that helps with under eye bags. I've been using for about 45 days and the results are significant. I feel like I don't have to wear concealer anymore.

avis.titre: A natural product that really works
avis.texte: So many of the natural skincare brands I've tried just don't bring results. Mad Hippie is different thouhg. I've been using their products for several years and this one is definitely a staple. My eyes look brighter and the discoloration I sometimes get right under my eyes is pretty much gone.

It's hard to find a clean eye cream that has real active ingredients in it. After doing a bit of research I wanted to give this one a try and I'm so happy I did. I think it's really helped with my saggy skin under my eyes. I look a bit more refreshed and this product doesn't have any bad ingredients in it.

avis.titre: My eyes look way more awake!
avis.texte: I used to layer concealer like crazy and now I barely need it. My eyes look more awake and way less tired, even when I'm not sleeping great. This one's a keeper.
Obsessed. It feels super lightweight but somehow makes my whole eye area look brighter and more hydrated. I've been using it morning and night and can actually see a difference.

avis.titre: a little goes a long way
avis.texte: I was skeptical (aren't eye creams just expensive moisturizers?) but this one actually does something. My under-eyes look smoother and less puffy in the mornings. A little goes a long way too, which I love.

Light and absorbing formula. Feels really good on my skin. I like the smell and feel and would buy this again for sure. Licorice is a great ingredient to have as its good for your dark circles under the eyes. I think it has really helped me a lot.

Peptides, niacinamide and caffeine is exactly what you need for your delicate skin around the eyes. It's just so hard to find a product with these ingredients that is natural. Do yourself a favor and pick this little bottle up and you can thank me later :)

avis.titre: for the price its a winner
avis.texte: I seem to drift around from brand and brand when it comes to eye cream. I like a lighter cream in the summer and a heavier one in the winter. This product has been a regular in my schedule. It falls right in the middle for moisture, which I do like

This product has a lot of niacinamide. I can feel it tingle when I put it on, which I personally love. It has brightened my eye area a lot which I think is probably the niacinamide and the peptides. I love that it is all natural and doesn't have harmful ingredients like a lot of eye creams I've used.

This eye cream just does it. It's hydrating and the circles under my eyes have def become less noticeable. So yeah, I would have to say it's my favorite eye cream out there. Oh and the ingredients are super clean so that's another plus for me. 10/10

About 5 minutes after I applyed onto my eyes, my face started getting hot and I looked in the mirror and both of my cheeks and forehead were red, burning and slightly puffy. Ive never had this reaction before from any skincare product and I know it was this eye cream because it was the only new product I had used. I really was hoping I'd love this due to their branding, ingredients and price. The irritation lasted for almost an hour and was very bright red.

I have minor wrinkles around my eyes and often wake to puffiness. I think this product has actually helped a lot as my wrinkles seem less pronounced than before. I also notice I don't have as much puffiness around my eyes when I wake. I am pretty impressed overall.

This product I was a bit skeptical of at first but it really does what it promises. I think it's the peptides and the caffeine but it truly has helped with the discoloration under my eyes. I used to wake up and have to ice around my eyes to not look like a freak but now with this product I no longer am needing ice. My mom is now using it and also is a fan.
Bad reaction to this cream. Burning and red reaction to the cream.

A low fuss, high quality eye cream. I'll be buying this again and again. It was irritating at all (even after sweating/possibly getting it into my eyes), and my eyes looked noticably refreshed. Plus, it smells good and the package is made from a bio material versus traditional plastic (yay!).

I was so happy to see ulta start carrying this product. I have been a fan of mad hippie for a bit and found them at an organic grocery store near me in Denver. This product is probably my favorite though. It sinks right in to the skin and my skin just loves it.
Thiss product has made my bags a lot less noticeable. It was on the second bottle that i really started noticing. Just stick with it as it takes a min but its well worth it.
Thiss product has made my bags a lot less noticeable. It was on the second bottle that i really started noticing. Just stick with it as it takes a min but its well worth it.

It has a lot of niacinamide, which is amazing for the skin. It can make me a bit tingly after, but it has really helped with my wrinkles andd under eye bags. I would definitley recommend to anyone looking for a good eye cream.

avis.titre: My eyes look so much better now
avis.texte: Im not sure if its the peptides or caffeine or one of the other many actives but this product has really helped with my under eye circles. It took probably 1-2 months to really see the resutls but Im so glad I stuck with it. I use the face cream too and love them both.

avis.titre: My eyes look so much better now
avis.texte: Im not sure if its the peptides or caffeine or one of the other many actives but this product has really helped with my under eye circles. It took probably 1-2 months to really see the resutls but Im so glad I stuck with it. I use the face cream too and love them both.
I've tried EVERY eye cream. Of the 10-15 I've tried, this one takes the cake. My dark circles, puffiness, all gone!!
This formula really packs a punch! I notice such a big difference after only using it for a couple of weeks. Definitely reordering!
I've been using this Product for at least most of the year and I haven't seen good results at all. If anything it's made my eyes look worse than before.
This burned skin around my eyes in less than an hour of applying!! See photo.
My eyes are always puffy in the mornings, but this stuff helps so much and smooths the skin beautifully. I've tried many products to help with this bus Madhippie is my favorite by far!
My eyes are always puffy in the mornings, but this stuff helps so much and smooths the skin beautifully. I've tried many products to help with this bus Madhippie is my favorite by far!

Smooths, softens, brightens, and de-puffs under eye area using 2 times per day. Definitely saw results after a week. I'm a huge fan of peptides and niacinamide. I have read a lot about licorice root for skin as well. This combo in this eye cream is perfect. Smells nice and has a warming effect when I apply. Must have eye cream.
Not sure what disagreed with my skin. My eyes were sore to touch after applying it for the third time.
I use it nightly and have really noticed a diminishing of under eye dark circles.

The eye cream is so smooth, smells wonderful and my eyes are beginning to look brighter and open up. I haven't been using it for very long but I think the longer I use it the better. I have used a lot of different eye creams but I like this one the best. It moisturizes my eyes better than the ones I have used before. It is smells heavenly.

At first I was a little disappointed at the size of this tube, but after my first time applying it I realized a little goes a LONG way and this formula really packs a punch! At first I was using it only at night but I find this really perks up my under eyes so have started using it in the morning too. So use to eye creams at this price point being basically just thick moisturizers. But this cream is filled to the brim with active ingredients-antioxidants and peptides galore (not to mention caffeine and licorice extract). You can tell Mad Hippie spends a great deal of effort optimizing their formulas and I'm so appreciative to have found a clean, trustworthy and affordable brand! Only request is please start a loyalty or points program bc I know I'll be stocking up!

I use Mad Hippie cleansing oil and serums so I thought I would give it a try. Always looking for another eye cream as a back up. Unfortunately it was too irritating to my skin around my eyes. Individual reaction-Mad Hippie has great products at great prices
I wouldn't mention the smell if this product didn't actually make my eyes look better. Not only does it reduce discoloration, the smell is so intoxicating.
I have allergies and tend to rub my eyes while I sleep often leaving them puffy and red. The cream is a rejuvenating, cooling sweet good morning for my roughed up eyes.

avis.titre: Cured burning, pain and tiredness in my eyes
avis.texte: I was not expecting this but I have no more pain in my eyes, no burning, itching, dryness and tiredness. As long as I'm using this product. And honestly, I feel refreshed right after applying. It must be the ingredients))) and combination of them. Thank you!
Like how this product feels on my skin, love that it does not have an odor. Feel that it does its job. Am a repeat customer.

avis.titre: The only eye cream that works
avis.texte: I've tried probably 10-15 different eye creams and either some of them kind of worked or didn't make a difference at all. I bought this eye cream at my local sprouts market to give it a try for my dark circles and let me tell you my dark circles were awful. It's only been one week and I don't look like a zombie anymore. Thank you guys so much. I will definitely be trying out the rest of your products.

I have super sensitive skin and react to a lot of eye creams (and I have tried a lot) this one is so gentle on my skin and hydrating. It sits well under makeup as well! I've never had a problem with it messing with my makeup. I have repurchased this so many times now! I recommend it to everyone!

I finally found an under eye cream that agrees with! I can't tell you how many I have gone through or the company changed the ingredients and it caused my delicate skin to turn red and puff up with burning inflammation. My skin was already grumpy from trying a new spf moisturizer in the morning but I dared to go ahead and try this product. I am so glad I did because it immediately relieved my stressed skin. Love it! it does smell a little weird but it's very faint. The sent is probably from there fruit extract used.
I've been using this product for almost a year, and I've definitely seen a difference in my dark circles.

The skin around my eye area is super picky. I have tried all kinds of creams from super expensive to everyday brands. Some swelled my eyes up on contact. I have been using this for about a week.it's moisturizing,but not greasy & I have had no adverse reaction. A big win in my book

I bought a whole bunch of MH products on a whim and have been quite impressed with them, especially since they are decently priced. I started the eye cream after the other products, cautiously at first as I have had eczema around my eyes before. I have had no adverse reaction to it (it's been 10 days) and I know it is supposed to take a few months to take effect but I have noticed the little grainy bumps on the skin under my eyes are starting to vanish. The skin looks nicer too. Texture and smell of all the products have been very pleasing (I am quite sensitive to scent).
This formula absorbs quickly and is very hydrating without being oily.

It takes a few months to see the full effect, but this eye cream is great! It has so many active ingredients for discoloration like caffeine, peptides, niacinamide, hesperidin. It's done a ton for my skin, just keep with it for a bit.

I recently discovered this brand at a Natural store and I'm in love. Everything about the brand, the ingredients, the name, the aesthetics of their packaging, how clean it is, being cruelty-free, and so much more. But more than that I love the products. My first buy was this eye cream. I've had a dark circle under my right eye for many years now and this is the one thing that has lessened it very very noticeably in just a few weeks (I wasn't even using it daily for the first week or so). It's smooth and light and a little goes a long way. The other day I grabbed 4 more items for facial skin care and I can say they're just magical. There's nothing that has ever made my skin feel so amazing. Now they need to initiate some sort of rewards system for frequent buyers. I can't wait to try more products.
I'm in love with this eye cream. It smells soooo good. I've been using all the time, morning, night, pre-makeup. Can't believe it took me so long to discover!
I really don't know if I like it yet. I always give a product at least a month and it has only been 2 weeks.

avis.titre: You can pry this out of my cold, dead hands
avis.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin in my late 30s. My eyes have had a persistent red crease in the outer corners. I have tried different eye creams and moisturizers but nothing has helped. I bought this on sale on a whim, and holy cow. I warm a small amount between my fingers, and pat all over my eye area. The first night I used it, the red crease was GONE. First time ever in years. I will buy this again. I'd recommend this to anyone with aging, dry, sensitive skin with red undertones. Only downside to note - peptides are not compatible with bha / aha so I only use this on nights I am not using a chemical exfoliant.

avis.titre: I wanted to love it but...
avis.texte: After the third day it left the skin under my eyes dry, itchy, red and irritated. I don't have any allergies so not sure what happened. Stopped using and within 3 days the skin under my eyes was back to normal. Just not for me

I dab a tiny, and I mean tiny amount am and pm. Puffiness reduced. Discoloration reduced, even after a really bad night. You have to give it a few minutes to soak in. I just brush my teeth while it does. Then my makeup goes on.

I love mad hippie products. Will always recommend them. But I think they changed their eye cream formula with this new packaging. My eyes are drier and I broke out in little red bumps. Not knocking the brand, just a heads up to all those with sensitive skin out there.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: This product is amazing. I have been using it for one week and I already see a dramatic difference in the eye area. I have used so many different eye creams and never have seen results like I see with the mad hippie eye cream❤️❤️❤️❤️
Didn't do anything that I could tell. It is very soft though.

I had a difficult time finding eye cream that worked for the puffiness and dryness around my eyes, either it would burn or didn't have the moisture that I needed. I gave this a try...WOW!! I have finally found the holy grail of eye creams!! I have since purchased several more Mad Hippie products and I am in love!! As far as I'm concerned-best products out there! Thank you, Mad Hippie!!

I recently bought this eye cream about a month ago and have been using it every night since. In just a month I've noticed so much of a difference. I've have really bad dark circles for as long as I can remember and for the past 5 years I have been trying to get rid of them and this is the only product that has actually made a difference. I can't wait to see how much of an improvement there will be after 3 months.

Let me start by saying I love Mad Hippies products. I've been using the exfoliating serum, the vitamin A serum, and the vitamin C serum for 2 years now. I decided to give the eye cream a try and unfortunately it made both of my eyes swell almost completely shut. I'm assuming that I had an allergic reaction.

Had high hopes for this but won't repurchase. On the upside, it didn't irritate my eyes. It was moisturizing BUT in terms of helping dark circles, puffiness or reduced lines, nothing at all. I realize nothing is a miracle cure and the price point is modest, I would rather spend a bit more and have at least some results. Also, I didnt care for the fragrance.

I purchased and used the older product that came in a pump container. I loved it. This new version causes my eyes to water and burn terribly, I will not be purchasing again. I would not recommend to anyone with sensitive eyes.
Best eye cream ever! Does it's job! My eyes look great and it has reduce the puffiness under my eyes! I have very bad dark circles and this has changed it so much! Thank you!
Have seen a vast improvement in dark circles under eyes..highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: Packaging is different but still nice
avis.texte: Packaging is different from the product photo-it's a pump, but other than that I like this eye cream
The discoloration under my eyes is so much better after just a few weeks. Will never stop using this product!

I bought this on a whim, looking for something for my sensitive skin that would cover all the bases...aging, circles, puffiness, etc. I noticed an immediate difference in my undereyes and it keeps getting better. Also, it's not super expensive, and one tiny pump is enough for both eyes. I'll def be checking out this brand's other products!

nice texture, soaks in well, more hydrating than other eye creams/serums I've tried (many). Why does it smell like watermelon? it does dissipate, but I really dislike it. Otherwise, it seems like the best affordable option containing ceramides. At night I sometimes layer it with borage oil for extra hydration (I had dry skin even before it was mature). good alone for day time. Only used while traveling for 2 weeks so I can't speak to the long-term corrective effects.

I have hereditary discoloration under my eyes. I've tried so many things to help! This eye cream has done a lot for me. It took a few months to really start to see the effect but I would say now after 6 months I've seen around a 70% improvement. I still have some discoloration but when compared to pictures from a year back, I'm very happy to see the improvement. I love that the product is so clean and the newer formula is definitely more hydrating. I like to put this on after my vitamin C serum and before my makeup in the morning.

I have used this product for a little over 3 months now. While it has done a great job moisturizing my eye area, it has done little for my dark circles. Could be that I need something a little stronger.. I like that a little product goes a long way, so the bottle has lasted me longer than I expected.

I recently lost my mom after she was done fighting pancreatic cancer for a year. Many sleepless nights, stress and lots of tears caused some serious discoloration and severe dryness under my eyes. Literally looked like I had black eyes last week. 1 week of twice/day use……….Miracle! Complete turn around!
You're not going to get overnight results but this eye cream does really help with regular use. I like that it has all the actives I wanted but is also really clean.

I had used the old formula for a year and really liked it; felt that it helped with fine lines, discoloration and even to decrease some under-eye puffiness. I have been using this new formula for a few weeks now and do not like it. I feel like it actually causes under-eye puffiness, almost like a reaction to this new formula under my right eye specifically. I stopped using it for a couple of days and the puffiness went away. Tried it again and it came back. As a side note- though I really liked the old formula, I did go snow skiing for a full day this past winter on a beautiful sunny day. Lots of rays! The next several days I had quite puffy under-eye areas to both sides. I had not used any other products, no sunscreen (yes, I forgot to apply and forgot my sunglasses!) and felt that I had a reaction to this product. Unfortunately, I will not be repurchasing this product.

I will start by saying the thing that's truly amazing about this product is the bottle it comes in. Considering I bought it twice in a year and used it twice daily, one bottle lasted 6 months! Which is impressive compared to any other 30ml bottle I've ever used of any product! It's easy to just use a little and it allows you to every spec of it. I love that and was super impressed by it lasting so long! The cream is light and feels nice, absorbs nicely but I'm just not sure that it actually did anything noticeable for me after a year of using it!

I love this eye cream along with all of Mad Hippie's products! I know some people have complained about the dispenser getting clogged but if you use twice a day there is no problem. Don't let that stop you from buying this great product.

I was very disappointed in this. I bought several hundred dollars worth of mad hippie products and this gave me awful red rashes all over my eyes. I do not have sensitive skin so this is very odd for me. Additionally, it didnt feel very hydrating. I contacted customer service who said I could ship it back at my own expense for a refund. However, with having spent so much money I figured the courtesy would have been for mad hippie to cover that costs.
This eye cream works well for helping with my tired looking eyes. I'm not sure if it's the peptides or the antioxidants but my eyes definitely have much less of a dark shade to them.

I had searched for a natural eye cream with peptides and licorice after doing a lot of research on safe ingredients that help. I've had dark circles under my eyes for years. Mostly hereditary, I think, though they do get worse during times of stress. I've been using this eye cream for just under a year. I apply every night after washing my face and applying my vitamin A serum. I've definitely seen a big improvement though the results took a little time to show for me. When I look at pics from a year back I definitely see a big improvement. I will continue to use.

avis.titre: I really want to like this
avis.texte: Dark circles under my eyes are the main reason I bought this eye cream. This product doesn't do anything for me other than moisturize and smell wonderful. I use and love the Mad Hippie face cream and will probably just supplement with that when my eye cream runs out.
Very smooth and hydrating but sometimes I get a burning sensation so I stopped using it. When I stopped my skin became so dry it began to peel beside my eye and on the lids

I really liked this cream the first time I tried it. The pump wouldn't work so I had to take the top off and manually do it but got the product out nonetheless. Though after two days of use the skin around my eyes was so sore, and when I looked closer I had a rash around both of my eyes. I quit using it immediately. I couldn't find anywhere to contact the company about it?

I use this inexpensive eye cream after cleansing & moisturizing every am & pm. It comes in such a small bottle but don't let that fool you. It takes such a small amount of product to moisturize each eye. White cream as being applied turn to a serum like consistency. Have had no stinging or burning with applications. It is working great & after just 1 week of use I see improvements in fine lines, wrinkles & under eye bags & discoloration. Will not hesitate to purchase again.

I have been using this product for about 4-5 months semi-regularly and haven't run out yet. I am happy with it and have no reason to dislike it! On the flip side, I wouldn't be upset if it was sold out and I had to purchase a different eye cream. I am still open to options but this is doing the job. It goes on nicely and does not cause me any problems. I can't tell if the product is working and doing all the things it claims to, but I'm not about to use it on only one eye to compare results, so --- I am happy with it and only gave it 4 stars because it doesn't make me insanely excited or like I feel it's the best eye cream ever. It's just good :)
I love this product, it's great for us dry skins folks! The no fragrance thing is huge for me, i breakout easily!

I bought this because of the great reviews. This eye cream did absolutely nothing for my under eye area. Once it soaked in, it was gone and my skin was dry. It didn't help with my fine lines. This is supposed to help with discoloration, which I didn't have, but after using this for two weeks, I had dark circles. It's overpriced. There are much better options out there. I went back to using Glossier's Bubblewrap because that actually works.

The eye cream works great and is very moisturizing! But please improve the packaging. I used it for about 2 weeks and the pump stopped working. I think product may have dried inside and clogged the pump. I'm sad because there's still a lot of product left I can't use!
My eyes sure feel soft and smooth using this just after a couple days of use! I LOVE the smell. It's floral yet subtle and absolutely incredible.
This is the only eye cream I've actually seen results from! Would recommend!

Not the worst eye cream I've ever tried but my eyes sometimes react and also there is a strong smell, I read through the Ingredients and didn't find an added fragrance, but it does seem to have a smell.

I was going to wait a couple months before reviewing because I haven't noticed any dramatic changes in fine lines or dark circles yet, BUT I'm honestly skeptical that any cream can truly deliver that with the exception of products with retinol. So, here it is. MY EYE AREA HAS NEVER FELT SO SMOOTH AND HYDRATED. I want to rub it all over my face because I just want it to feel as amazing as my lids and under eye area do (I'll be getting the face cream next to see if it can deliver). But this stuff is awesome. Seriously. It did decrease some puffiness as well. I have sensitive skin and I can even put this on my eyelids with no problem. I've tried several eye creams, none of which even compared to this stuff. I am praying to the Mad Hippie gods that they never change or discontinue it because it is everything I've wanted in an eye cream.
Dark eye circles run in my family and I really notice a difference with this product. I usually use it once or twice a day.
It's been about 4 months since I started this. It took a bit to help with my eye discoloration but now it's definitely noticeable. You have to stick with it but I am very happy with the results

Pros: Great texture. Perfect amount of moisturizing for my skin. Leaves my undereye noticeably smoother, plumper. No irritation or allergic issues. Very nice general cream. Cons: Very strong, floral/rosey scent! It does fade in a few minutes. No noticeable improvement to my dark circles, which is my primary concern.

This is the only eye cream I like to use. Does not irritate my sensitive skin and works well with contacts. It does not creep into my eyes. Moisturizes well without being greasy. Has decreased my dark circles and fine lines. My eyes look more awake and my skin around the eyes is smoother and plump. Little bit goes a long way. Would love to be able to tell how much is left in the packaging and would love to see sugar resin tubes instead of the current pump jar unless this jar came from PCR plastic anyways. I would also be okay with a small glass jar and wooden spoon. Either way this product performs super well and I could not be happier. I think it will help my eye area to look younger for longer and keep my skin happy. Love the all natural but yet effective ingredients. Thanks for not using phenoxyethanol or other synthetic preservatives which can be irritating the eye area.

The eye cream's got a very good texture and nice smell. The package is great for eye cream. The only curiosity I have is where the nice smell come from. I read the full ingredients and there's no perfume or fragrance shown so I hope it's the smell of the ingredients which hopefully is safe to use with the eye area. Anyway, I decided to buy this eye cream just because I totally fall in love with the Vit C serum so hope I would fall for this product too :)

avis.titre: Love the product, don't love the packaging
avis.texte: I truly love this eye cream, but I find the pump tube to be frustrating. Little bits of lotion always dry on the inside of the tube which causes the pump to clog. I hate wasting little bits of such a great product each time I use it. Wish this came in a little jar instead.

avis.titre: Love the Product BUT Not the Packaing
avis.texte: Love this eye cream, and it is a great product to use in combination with the other Mad Hippie products I use. HOWEVER, I echo the other reviews which ask for different packaging so that we know in advance when we are getting ready to run out of the product.

I had been using an expensive eye product purchased from a cosmetic dermatologist and started to get eye irritation after a long time of use. I needed to find another eye cream and I found Mad Hippie at a natural food store, read the literature, the box and I bought it. My eye irritation went away after a few days and I love it!! I was very happy to find it at my local Ulta. I am very happy with the company's philosophy and ingredients. I have a bought a few other products to try too. I am a convert.

I am very sensitive to cosmetics and creams. I have no reaction to Mad Hippie eye cream. It has an impressive list of ingredients and still remains gentle enough that I do not get red eyes or burning.
I use it daily. It goes on very smoothly and rubs in well. Little goes a long way. Seems to help my eye puffiness.

I use this every night before bed. I've noticed reduced puffiness under my eyes!!! I haven't noticed anything different with fine lines, but I'm skeptical any cream can totally prevent them. It's a small bottle but a little goes a long way! I carefully press out a tiny drop of lotion because it's all you need to cover the entire under eye area. This is my first Mad Hippie product and I liked this one so much I bought their face cream. I only buy cruelty free products so I'm happy to find another brand I like, especially one with natural ingredients :)
I've been using this product for about 3 1/2 months now and haven't noticed any difference in my fine lines. It does however moisturize my eyes.

avis.titre: Love Product But Not The Pump
avis.texte: I really like this eye cream but the pump dispenses too much product. I have to be careful to not push the pump all the way down or else I get so much product that I can moisturize my whole face. The manufacturer should change that.
This eye cream took about 2 months for me to see the real results but now that I have, I'm hooked!!
I've used this product for about a year and have always like it. The new formula though I like even more! So happy caffeine and licorice were added. It also seems a bit more hydrating - which I love!

Not as magical as it sounds. I've only been using it for a bit, but don't notice any results at all. Also, when i put it on, it goes on clumpy? Whether I pat it on or gently rub it in, it leaves little clumps. Not sure if I got a bad product or what

I decided to try this product after a local talk show featured it on a segment done by an esthetician. It was on her best products under 30.00 list. I'm so glad I tried it. A tiny little goes a long way. It smooths the skin under my eyes without feeling heavy.

It didn't do anything bad but everytime I apply it something in the product clumps up and turns into little silicon-y balls. It's annoying but I also don't know what it means about the product's condition.
I've always had tired looking eyes with bags. Agree 2 months of using this eye cream though my skin is starting to look a lot better.

avis.titre: Takes a month or so but it's great
